proof_body:
by
  intro E _ f a b c hab hbc
  constructor
  · simpa using eVariationOn.Icc_add_Icc f (s := Set.univ) hab hbc (Set.mem_univ b)
  · exact eVariationOn.edist_le f (Set.left_mem_Icc.2 (hab.trans hbc)) (Set.right_mem_Icc.2 (hab.trans hbc))
target_source: ∀ (E : Type*) [PseudoEMetricSpace E] (f : ℝ → E) (a b c : ℝ), a ≤ b → b ≤ c → eVariationOn f (Set.Icc a b) + eVariationOn f (Set.Icc b c) = eVariationOn f (Set.Icc a c) ∧ edist (f a) (f c) ≤ eVariationOn f (Set.Icc a c)
